title: About your centre
text: Replace with 2–3 sentences: who you help, subjects or services, key USP (small groups, qualified tutors, etc.).

title: Subjects and programmes
text: List subjects, year groups, and programmes (e.g. GCSE boards, FCL). Mention free skills assessment.

title: Session times (informational)
text: Regular session times for information only. State that bookings are confirmed by phone after assessment.

title: Free skills assessment
text: What the assessment involves, duration, no pressure, how to book (team calls to confirm). Include phone number.

title: Pricing and fees
text: Published fee ranges or how pricing works. Invite assessment call for exact quote.
